instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih11_window_elevation_seed.dxf. Complete the hard window elevation. Draw FRAME rectangle (0,0)-(2400,1600), vertical mullions (800,0)-(800,1600) and (1600,0)-(1600,1600), transom (0,600)-(2400,600), SWING diagonals (40,640)-(760,1560), (840,640)-(1560,1560), and (1640,640)-(2360,1560), SWING arcs radius 360 at centers (40,640), (840,640), and (1640,640), three HATCH glass fills in the lower panels, and labels WINDOW W-204, 2400, 1600, and GLASS TYP. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih11_window_elevation_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
